## Projects

- [MCP Arena](https://github.com/myz96/mcparena): Open-source MCP evaluation and optimisation system. Scores MCP servers on task success, correctness, latency, and cost using DSPy and GEPA against MCP-Bench.
- Agent Evals: In progress. An open-source framework to set up verifiable evals for any agent quickly.
